regulatory_note: UK Overseas Territory; the Maritime Authority of the Cayman Islands is a major Red Ensign registry — a sophisticated certification counterpart. Port Authority + Dept of Tourism procurement channels.
seasonality: Atlantic hurricane season (Jun–Nov) is the constraint; the North Sound is protected. Winter is peak tourism; corporate demand is year-round.
summary: Grand Cayman is one of the world's largest offshore-finance centres, with dense waterfront business and resort activity around George Town, Seven Mile Beach and the North Sound. Its Sister Islands — Cayman Brac and Little Cayman — sit ~75 nm east, reachable only by Cayman Airways prop flights today, making them a natural Quanta-LR link. The corporate-mobility and luxury-resort demand on Grand Cayman pairs with a clear inter-island lifeline case.
tagline: A global finance hub with a captive Sister-Islands link and a premium waterfront corporate corridor.
